formal_rule: Store every geometry, topology, profile, event and schedule as a typed content-addressed record.
Reject unknown IDs, duplicate IDs, invalid hashes and cycles.
Retain durable address, mode and lineage separately from geometric coordinates.
Declare parameter domain, frame, regularity and codomain.
Use negative/zero/positive for inside/boundary/outside.
Claim exact distance only for definitions that establish it.
Round/thicken a declared set by d(x,F)-epsilon; do not infer smoothness automatically.
Name ports, coordinate transport, orientation, sheet and lineage updates.
Equal coordinates do not imply equality or coupling.
Periodic x wrap plus y-seam x reflection and orientation bit.
Use H=(pivot/state/map/guard/invariants) for continuous, discrete and connector hinges.
Represent time as a declared coordinate/domain, not an implicit bit or homogeneous coordinate.
Use a versioned closed form or bounded predictor for state evolution.
Prune candidates before compatibility and root solving.
Admit only declared sheets/routes/branches/profiles.
Require root/sign evidence, guard band, direction, confidence and numerical margin.
Keep mode state piecewise constant and change it atomically only at a verified event.
Append pre/post state, time, relation, residual, route, parents and definition trace.
Use 11/12/10/3/1 continuous log-spherical/symbol/parity bits.
Use a self-inverse 16x16 logical address permutation.
Reconstruct from KLB37 base, fixed grammar, node predictor and bounded sparse novelty.
Reconstruct coarse orbital state from 64-byte seeds and hash-linked time tiles.
Parse, normalize, resolve, construct, evolve, support, compatibility, guard, transition, lineage.
R^7 supplies seven mutually orthogonal standard axes; this is optional and not the current R^3 KLB default.
KLSC1 parent walk is bounded by checkpoint stride <=64; bounded is not zero-cost.
Use SHA-256 for definition content addressing and FNV-1a only for supplied binary-chain integrity.
Promote a profile only when reconstruction and solver error stay below the event margin at the required cost.
